brand.tagline: The Digital Home of Property Management
brand.description: Turkey's first AI-augmented, WhatsApp-native, multi-tenant property management platform. Dues, expenses, announcements, maintenance, polls, meetings and debt enforcement in one panel.

legal.complianceNote: Built to comply with Turkish Data Protection Law (KVKK No. 6698) and the Condominium Act (No. 634).
legal.kvkkRightsNote: For your rights regarding your personal data, see the <kvkk>Privacy Notice</kvkk>

reason.payment_already_cancelled: This payment has already been voided.
reason.card_payment_requires_refund: Card payments cannot be voided here; refund them at the payment provider.
reason.erasure_requires_erase_action: An erasure request cannot be closed with "Resolve"; use "Apply erasure" so the data is actually removed.
reason.erasure_subject_still_member: The person is still registered on the site. Remove them from the Residents screen first.
reason.erasure_open_debts: The person has unpaid debts; identity cannot be erased before they are settled.
reason.erasure_subject_active_elsewhere: The person is still registered on another site, so their identity cannot be erased; nothing was changed. Reply to the requester accordingly.
reason.erasure_subject_unknown: The requester is not a registered person on this site; there is nothing to erase.
reason.not_erasure_request: This is not an erasure request.
reason.kvkk_request_already_open: You already have an open request of the same type.
reason.subject: The requester was not found on this site.
reason.promo_other_tenant: This code is restricted to another site.
reason.promo_already_used: This site has already used the code.
reason.tenant_archived: The site is archived; restore it first.
reason.trial_plan_not_assignable: The trial plan cannot be assigned.
reason.start_out_of_range: The start date must be within one year of today.
reason.announcement_already_published: A published announcement cannot be edited or deleted; you can withdraw it.
reason.announcement_not_published: This announcement is not published yet.
